spec.name: M7.ActualPresentation.four_field_order
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (g h : M7.Action.Record N), (M7.ActualPresentation.encode g ≤ M7.ActualPresentation.encode h ↔ (g.unit : ZMod N).val < (h.unit : ZMod N).val ∨ (g.unit : ZMod N).val = (h.unit : ZMod N).val ∧ (g.exchange < h.exchange ∨ g.exchange = h.exchange ∧ (g.leftShift.val < h.leftShift.val ∨ g.leftShift.val = h.leftShift.val ∧ g.rightShift.val ≤ h.rightShift.val)))
spec.guidance: Unfold encode and nested Prod.Lex.toLex_le_toLex. UnitKey order is explicitly lifted from unit.val; equality of unit codes iff unit equality uses ZMod.val_injective and Units.ext. Fin comparisons use their natural val. This is exactly the original four-field lex order, not product partial order. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.ActualPresentation.realize_decode

spec.guidance: The two actual affine images are exactly the generic left/right realization by definition. Unfold realize,leftImage,rightImage,decode,act; both fields agree, including exchange. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.ActualPresentation.leastAction_spec
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c q : M7.Action.Recipe N), (∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.ActualPresentation.leastAction c q = some g ↔ M7.Action.act g c = q ∧ ∀ h : M7.Action.Record N, M7.Action.act h c = q → M7.ActualPresentation.encode g ≤ M7.ActualPresentation.encode h) ∧ (M7.ActualPresentation.leastAction c q = none ↔ ¬ ∃ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.Action.act g c = q)
spec.guidance: Instantiate accepted targetLeast_spec with the actual Outer/FinN domains and left/right affine image functions. Rewrite domain_univ and realize_decode. encode/decode are inverse, so Option.map decode preserves the exact least-preimage specification; use encode g to transport any actual record back to the encoded domain. Algorithm remains factorized. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.ActualPresentation.winning_fiber
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (m : ℕ) (feasible : M7.Action.Recipe N → Prop) (objective : M7.Action.Recipe N → Fin m → ℤ) (mode : M7.Selection.Mode) (g h : M7.Action.Record N), M7.Action.act g c = M7.Action.act h c → (g ∈ M7.ActualPresentation.selected c feasible objective mode ↔ h ∈ M7.ActualPresentation.selected c feasible objective mode)
spec.guidance: Unfold actual selected and use accepted M7.Selection.selector_exact, or its win_sound_complete predicate. Both feasibility and objective are functions of the literal realized recipe. Same physical pair implies the same comparisons. This does not assume action-invariance of an unconnected label. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.ActualPresentation.presentation_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (m : ℕ) (feasible : M7.Action.Recipe N → Prop) (objective : M7.Action.Recipe N → Fin m → ℤ) (mode : M7.Selection.Mode) (g : M7.Action.Record N), g ∈ M7.ActualPresentation.selected c feasible objective mode → ∃! h : M7.Action.Record N, M7.ActualPresentation.present c feasible objective mode h ∧ M7.Action.act h c = M7.Action.act g c
spec.guidance: leastAction at the winning image has a preimage, hence is some h by leastAction_spec. It has the same literal image, so winning_fiber makes h winning; it is present by its leastAction equality. Any other present record with that image gives the same Option result, hence uniqueness. Every actual tied presentation is returned once. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.ActualPresentation.presentation_sound
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (m : ℕ) (feasible : M7.Action.Recipe N → Prop) (objective : M7.Action.Recipe N → Fin m → ℤ) (mode : M7.Selection.Mode) (g : M7.Action.Record N), M7.ActualPresentation.present c feasible objective mode g → g ∈ M7.ActualPresentation.selected c feasible objective mode ∧ ∀ h : M7.Action.Record N, M7.Action.act h c = M7.Action.act g c → M7.ActualPresentation.encode g ≤ M7.ActualPresentation.encode h
spec.guidance: Unfold present; retain actual winning membership and apply leastAction_spec to get least-preimage minimality. No default-query label hypothesis is added here; the next batch instantiates feasible/objective with literal signature, locality and actual M6 distance. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
